rules.approval_means: Keep in Ruthie's open font library for any future purpose; approval does not replace, rank, or finalize another font.
rules.license_gate: Open/commercial-use font license must be verified before a family is retained.
rules.provenance_gate: Retain designer/source/history provenance with the family.
rules.review_ui: YES/NO controls appear at the end of each candidate card; no MAYBE control.

families.name: ADAXI
families.designer_source: La Scuola Open Source / Bari Città Aperta workshop
families.provenance_note: Collectively designed during the Bari Città Aperta XYZ workshop; upstream repository includes CREDITS, README, sources, and OFL.txt.

families.name: Frames Part One
families.provenance_note: Designer-distributed monospace family; designer readme explicitly permits use/modify/distribute under OFL and requests credit/tagging as a courtesy.

families.name: Sprat
families.provenance_note: Upstream designer repository includes Licence_OFL.txt, README, specimen PDF, and supplied font binaries.

families.name: Bagnard
families.provenance_note: Inspired by graffiti carved by an anonymous prisoner of the Napoleonic wars; upstream includes UFO source, README, and OFL.txt.

families.name: Dauphine
families.designer_source: Stéphanie Vilayphiou, Alexandre Leray, Coline Sunier & Charles Mazé
families.provenance_note: Designed for the ÉSAD Grenoble Valence visual identity and influenced by late-19th/early-20th-century map lettering; upstream includes UFO source, FONTLOG, specimen material, and OFL.txt.

families.name: DOF
families.provenance_note: Parametric METAFONT-based type system; upstream documents source files, parameters, generated families, and OFL licensing.

families.name: Version
families.provenance_note: Versioned/generative font experiment; upstream README states all generated fonts are under SIL OFL and preserves the generation scripts and SVG source workflow.

families.name: Half
families.provenance_note: Four-cut geometric family; upstream README explicitly states OFL and repository preserves binaries plus fontlog.

families.name: Optician Sans
families.provenance_note: Based on historical eye-chart optotypes and extended into a complete display face; official repository contains LICENSE.md and multiple source/output formats.

families.name: Hyde
families.provenance_note: Designed in 2008 during the MA Typeface Design program at the University of Reading; upstream README explicitly states OFL 1.1 and preserves OTFs, VFB sources, specimen, and build materials.

families.name: Aldone
families.provenance_note: Independent geometric sans project; upstream includes OFL.txt, README, sources, documentation, and compiled fonts.

families.name: St. Martin
families.provenance_note: Experimental revival of a recurring typographic artifact found in Jean-Alexis Rouchon's 19th-century posters; official project documents the research lineage and OFL status.

families.name: Amarna
families.provenance_note: Independent humanist/semi-glyphic family; upstream repository includes AUTHORS, CONTRIBUTORS, OFL.txt, sources, variable fonts, static fonts, and webfonts.

families.name: Yuyu
families.provenance_note: Personal-identity typeface project with main and Short branches; upstream includes AUTHORS, CONTRIBUTORS, OFL.txt, documentation, sources, and compiled font formats.

families.name: FT88
families.designer_source: Ange Degheest; revival by EESAB Rennes team
families.provenance_note: Revival from Ange Degheest's archive of Minitel-era alphabets commissioned by France Telecom; distributed by Velvetyne under OFL 1.1 with archival/revival history.

families.name: Serrería Extravagante
families.provenance_note: Collaboratively drawn from lettering on Madrid's Serrería Belga façade during the From Stone to Spaceship workshop; released with FONTLOG and Open Font License.

families.name: Cerne
families.provenance_note: Research-driven color font based on the ninth-century Book of Cerne script, with modern/historical modes and pigment-informed color behavior; upstream includes OFL.txt, Glyphs sources, guide/specimen material, and webfont.
